name: Innami Kouzou
source:
He is a former member of the Yagumo Group, but was expelled for dealing drugs, which is prohibited by the group.
After that, using methods unknown, he gathered people and founded the Inami Group.  
Although it is a young group, it is rapidly increasing its membership and expanding its influence.

It secretly engages in illegal activities such as drug dealing.
Many of the group's members are immoral thugs.  

[Translated from [url=https://www.guilty-soft.com/guiltyex/ex03/chara.html]the official site[/url]]
